name: Yuki no Hate
source:
I didn't seem to be able to move a single step further.
The white snow covers the area, erasing all the footprints.
"... Serino"
I call out her name.
"Keep that child company... for me."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18264]official site[/url]]
